sloka: तथा ब्रुवाणं सुग्रीवं प्रहसन् लक्ष्मणोऽब्रवीत् ।कस्मिन्कर्मणि निर्वृत्ते श्रद्दध्या वालिनो वधम् ॥४-११-६९॥।।
transliteration: tathā bruvāṇaṁ sugrīvaṁ prahasan lakṣmaṇo'bravīt ।kasminkarmaṇi nirvṛtte śraddadhyā vālino vadham ॥4-11-69॥।।

translations.english: Smiling, Lakshmana asked Sugriva, 'By what action will you trust?. By the fulfilment of which task (by Rama) will you have faith?'
